partners.mechanism_chain: FTL (HGNC:3842) —DISRUPTS→ ferritin complex formation (GO:0006414); FTH1 (HGNC:3841) —DISRUPTS→ ferritin complex formation (GO:0006414); ferritin complex formation (GO:0006414) —DECREASES→ free iron (CHEBI:25019); free iron (CHEBI:25019) —INCREASES→ neurodegeneration (HP:0002180); free iron (CHEBI:25019) —INCREASES→ hypochromic microcytic anemia (HP:0004983). Mutations in FTL (for L-ferritin deficiency) or FTH1 (for MONDO:0014225) lead to haploinsufficiency, resulting in impaired formation of the functional ferritin complex. Elevated free iron can cause oxidative stress and damage, contributing to neurodegeneration and hypochromic microcytic anemia.
